decisions: A non-null parent identity selects the local scope marker and is framed in full.
The local function name remains its source name, without a namespace prefix.
AddFunction captures parents before recursively indexing local functions.
Module emission name ordering retains distinct local identities even when names match.
Find the nearest lexical function owner and select its captured declaration identity.
Validate the presence of a parent for a local and absence for a root.
Encode local scope and full parent with the same compiled header/tail field plans.
Use resolved IR parameter and result types for explicit and inferred local signatures.
Use one compilation function collector for full inventory and fixture projections; remove the previous duplicate probe collector.

productionHook.observation: The prepared snapshot, resolved types, final semantic type arrays, generic call plans and registration results are available before EmitContext construction. The next production integration must consume these current facts and preserve layout and registry ownership.

exploratoryRejectedInputs.observation: The current CSharp reference rejects generic local functions and path-qualified local names. These exploratory inputs did not authorize changing the language boundary and are not counted as implemented features.
